instruction: Candid intimate photograph, vertical medium shot. In a minimalist indoor space with a marble wall, a shirtless tattooed man (R1) sits behind a woman in a black dress (R2). The man (R1) rests his head back against the wall with his eyes closed, while the woman (R2) leans against his chest, also with eyes closed. He holds her gently from behind with his hands on her lap. Soft, warm, diffused lighting creates a serene, relaxed mood.
